quizzes_window.name: quizzes_window
quizzes_window.value: "app"."quizzes"."available_from" is null or "app"."quizzes"."available_until" is null or "app"."quizzes"."available_until" > "app"."quizzes"."available_from"

marks_score_outcome.name: marks_score_outcome
marks_score_outcome.value: ("app"."marks"."outcome" = 'score' and "app"."marks"."score" is not null and "app"."marks"."score" >= 0) or ("app"."marks"."outcome" <> 'score' and "app"."marks"."score" is null)

promotion_decisions_override_reason.name: promotion_decisions_override_reason
promotion_decisions_override_reason.value: "app"."promotion_decisions"."decision" is null or "app"."promotion_decisions"."decision"::text = "app"."promotion_decisions"."recommendation"::text or "app"."promotion_decisions"."override_reason" is not null

retention_holds_release.name: retention_holds_release
retention_holds_release.value: "app"."retention_holds"."released_at" is null or "app"."retention_holds"."released_by_account_id" is not null
